planets.name: L 168-9 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of L 168-9 with a 1.4-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: L 168-9 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around L 168-9. Its orbit and size follow Hobson et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
